concept: QJL residual correction needed or harmful
summary: Hannecke's survey reports the community independently found that at 3 or more bits putting all bits into Lloyd-Max centroids beats the paper's two-stage QJL scheme, so TurboQuant in practice is random rotation plus Lloyd-Max scalar quantization, while at 2.5 bits QJL remains necessary.
